items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: The interviewee discusses Sharkey Bonano and mentions Larry Shields sitting in, but Steve Smith is mentioned by the interviewer as a friend of the interviewer's who recommended hearing Larry Shields. The interviewee never claims a personal connection to Steve Smith.

ctx.x: And we played there for about a year or something. That's where he made all his money and he built a new place called Knicks.

In those days I was traveling around the country a lot. I was in the Depression and every time I'd come back to town, my friend would say, Steve Smith, say, you should have been here last week. Larry Shields sat in with the band. Yeah, yes. I never did get to hear Larry. Never in my life. He never? Only on record.
Oh, he played wonderful, wonderful. Well, in fact, Tommy Dorsey, Jimmy Dorsey, all of them came down and they'd sit in. We'd had a ball in that place.
